description: Source catalogue for the community-ground decision-evidence programme. A record describes a source family, not an ingested dataset release or an approved model input.

datasets.title: Civics workbook evidence registers
datasets.coverage: Existing Research Inputs and Qualification Register workbook sheets
limitations: Register status is reported by the workbook and is not independent source verification.
Workbook cells are versioned locations, not durable parameter definitions.

datasets.title: Bureau of Meteorology climate and solar data
datasets.coverage: Solar, temperature, rainfall and station/grid metadata for technical modelling
limitations: Long-run averages and coarse grids do not establish site extremes or resilience.

datasets.title: ABS Data by Region and Data API
datasets.coverage: Population, income, labour, housing and regional context
limitations: ASGS edition, denominator and reference period must be frozen per release.
Area measures do not classify individuals or establish service demand.

datasets.title: ABS Socio-Economic Indexes for Areas
datasets.coverage: Area disadvantage and advantage indexes
limitations: Area ranks are not monetary values and must not be used to infer an individual's circumstances.

datasets.title: Higher Education Student Data
datasets.coverage: Higher education enrolments and attendance mode
limitations: External study does not establish mobility, housing insecurity or willingness to use a campsite.

datasets.title: NCVER Total VET students and courses
datasets.publisher: National Centre for Vocational Education Research
datasets.coverage: VET students, courses, delivery, location and attributes
limitations: Distinct students and enrolments must not be mixed; study enrolment does not establish accommodation need.

datasets.title: Working Holiday Maker program statistics
datasets.publisher: Australian Government Department of Home Affairs
datasets.coverage: Working Holiday Maker visa programme statistics
limitations: Visa grants or holders do not establish current local presence, work availability or demand for accommodation.

datasets.title: Temporary entrants in Australia statistics
datasets.publisher: Australian Government Department of Home Affairs
datasets.coverage: Point-in-time temporary entrant and New Zealand citizen stock data
limitations: Stock data does not establish local presence, individual legal conditions, service demand or a right to work.

datasets.title: ABS Overseas Arrivals and Departures
datasets.coverage: Overseas passenger movements by travel characteristics
limitations: Movements are not persons and must not be interpreted as local population, migration or demand.

datasets.title: Tourism Research Australia quarterly tourism labour statistics
datasets.coverage: Tourism filled jobs, industry and workforce characteristics
limitations: Filled jobs are not vacancies and do not establish the need for camping.

datasets.title: ABS Counts of Australian Businesses
datasets.coverage: Business entries, exits, survival and characteristics
limitations: A business event is not a personal outcome, insolvency event or accommodation need.

datasets.title: ASIC corporate insolvency statistics
datasets.coverage: Corporate external administrations and profiles
limitations: Company administration does not establish a director's personal financial position or housing need.

datasets.title: AFSA quarterly personal insolvency statistics
datasets.coverage: Formal personal insolvencies by administration and region
limitations: Formal insolvency excludes broader debt stress and does not establish suitability for camping.

datasets.title: AIHW Specialist Homelessness Services
datasets.publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare
datasets.coverage: Service clients, needs, support, housing situations and outcomes
limitations: SHS clients are not all people in need and the data cannot establish campground demand or suitability.

datasets.title: ABS Estimating Homelessness
datasets.coverage: Census-based estimates of homelessness
limitations: Census homelessness and service use are different concepts; neither is campground demand.

datasets.title: AIHW health workforce and National Health Workforce Dataset context
datasets.publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare
datasets.coverage: Registered health workforce size, distribution and selected employment characteristics
limitations: Workforce counts do not measure a person's wellbeing, exposure, leave status, accommodation need or desire for a recovery pathway.

datasets.title: Jobs and Skills Australia occupation, industry and NERO profiles
datasets.coverage: Occupation and industry employment context, including regional evidence
limitations: Occupation and industry profiles describe aggregate employment, not pressure, wellbeing, local site demand or individual circumstances.

datasets.title: Creative Australia creative workforce research
datasets.coverage: Professional artists, creative workforce and cultural economy research
limitations: Creative-work measures and cultural participation do not establish financial hardship, a commercial purpose, site demand or suitability.

datasets.title: eSafety image-based abuse research
datasets.coverage: Population research and pathways relating to image-based abuse
limitations: This is sensitive context and does not establish platform use, occupation, individual harm or site demand.

datasets.title: Public-interest disclosure, workplace protections and organisational-harm evidence
datasets.coverage: Aggregate disclosure, complaint and workplace-harm context
limitations: A report, complaint or application is not proof of wrongdoing, reprisals, trauma, job loss, destitution or site suitability.

datasets.title: ABS retirement, household income and wealth context
datasets.coverage: Retirement intentions and household income/wealth aggregates
limitations: Age, retirement, income and wealth do not establish capacity, willingness, purpose, values or governance entitlement.

datasets.title: Governed local participant, provider, employer and site evidence
datasets.coverage: Consent-based surveys, interviews, site data, service capacity, employer evidence and pilot follow-up
limitations: Requires purpose limitation, consent, independent review, disclosure control and participant interpretation.
Small or sensitive cohorts must not be published or used to create individual risk scores.

datasets.title: Site, utility, quote and commissioning evidence
datasets.coverage: Quotes, bills, interval loads, surveys, tests, permits, hazards and operating plans
limitations: Each record needs issuer, scope, exclusions, tax basis, validity date, review responsibility and an artifact hash.

datasets.title: Government cost-benefit analysis guides and outcome values
datasets.coverage: Appraisal methods, valuation guidance, price bases and discounting conventions
limitations: A method pack is not an observation and a published value needs jurisdiction, cohort, price-year and transferability review before model admission.

datasets.title: ABS Characteristics of Australian Business
datasets.coverage: Business innovation activity, collaboration, digital activity, skills, finance and reported barriers
limitations: Published data is primarily national/state context and does not establish a town's innovation infrastructure, a community's priorities, or a project's viability.
The 2024-25 innovation reference period and framework changed; comparisons with earlier releases require methodology review.
Business innovation data does not represent all community-led, public-interest, cultural or informal innovation.

datasets.title: Solid Databox Webcivics reference implementation and interoperability evidence
datasets.coverage: Organisation-side relationship Databoxes built on Community Solid Server 7.1.9; LDP, Solid-OIDC and WAC; governed exchange/receipts; IPMS retail, catalogue, pricing, discounts, loyalty, inventory, bookings, events and verifiable-credential modules
limitations: This is an organisation-side reference/demonstrator implementation, not an official upstream Community Solid Server distribution or an automatic production deployment.

The repository records independent external Solid interoperability assessment, production security review and production readiness as outstanding gates; do not represent implementation tests as independent interoperability proof.

A deployed Databox still requires tenant/program configuration, merchant/service-provider agreement, operational support, payment/inventory/booking integration and a locally governed data/credential policy.

datasets.title: Governed local merchant, service-provider and tourism-offering inventory
datasets.coverage: Consented service listings, discovery/booking pathways, inventory/commerce capability, fees, adoption barriers, accessibility and local-benefit terms
limitations: Listings, fees and availability change rapidly; public discovery must be provider-approved and independently reviewable.
Do not collect customer transaction histories, identity data, competitive terms or tourism-provider data without a specific purpose, consent and access controls.

datasets.title: AEMO Distributed Energy Resource Register and DER programme evidence
datasets.coverage: Aggregated distributed-energy-resource deployment, device visibility, demand flexibility and grid-integration context
limitations: Register data is aggregate context and cannot establish a community's available capacity, islanding capability, outage performance or bill savings.
Actual DER connections, operational controls and data access require applicable network, market and installer arrangements.

datasets.title: AER embedded-network, metering and consumer-protection guidance
datasets.coverage: Embedded-network customer rights, exempt selling, retailer choice, metering/market roles and billing protections
limitations: Energy selling, embedded-network and metering obligations vary by jurisdiction, arrangement and customer circumstances; a public guide is not legal, regulatory or engineering advice.
A software billing ledger does not authorise energy retailing, metering or disconnection.

datasets.title: Australian Disaster Resilience Knowledge Hub recovery principles and guidance
datasets.coverage: Community-centred, coordinated, inclusive and capacity-building disaster recovery guidance
limitations: National recovery principles do not prove that a site is safe, available, funded, authorised or capable during a specific event.
Disaster response and recovery must align with the responsible jurisdiction's emergency plans and specialist housing, health and safeguarding services.

datasets.title: AIHW Housing assistance in Australia
datasets.publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare
datasets.coverage: Social-housing dwellings, households, waitlists, greatest-need indicators, allocations, transfers and technical definitions
limitations: Waitlists measure eligible applicants/registers, not all underlying housing need, and may use consolidated lists or vary in coverage by programme and jurisdiction.
Dwellings, households, allocations and waitlist applicants are different units; they cannot be subtracted to create a universal housing shortfall.

datasets.title: Productivity Commission Report on Government Services: Housing and homelessness
datasets.coverage: Social-housing and specialist-homelessness performance, expenditure, recurrent cost per dwelling and jurisdictional data tables
limitations: Costs and service measures are not comparable across all jurisdictions or models; a recurrent cost per dwelling is not a per-person case cost or a marginal avoided cost.
Aggregate expenditure cannot establish that an alternative pathway reduces housing or health expenditure for a particular person.

datasets.title: AIHW Family, domestic and sexual violence data
datasets.publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare
datasets.coverage: Aggregate Australian measures on family, domestic and sexual violence, including prevalence, service, justice, health and help-seeking context.
limitations: Published aggregate measures do not identify a person's experience, safety, service need, accommodation suitability or likely use of a site.
Violence-related data has different populations, reference periods, collection methods and under-reporting patterns; measures must not be combined into a personal risk score or local demand estimate.
